title: Fresh Animations x Bare Bones Better Pigs
description: Gives pigs a longer snout and large ears. Warm variants have tusks
body:
This pack makes small changes to the pigs model and texture. Their snouts are now longer, and they have been given large ears. Their new texture changes their hooves and tail.

Warm pigs have small tusks. The baby warm pigs do not.

---

Requires [_Entity Model Features_](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitymodelfeatures) (or Optifine) and [_Fresh Animations_](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) version 1.10.0 or higher.

This is the version supporting fresh animations. You can find the vanilla version [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones-better-pigs).
\
Note that this is _not_ an addon pack. You will not need the vanilla version if you use the fresh animations one.

I have also created packs that improve [_chickens_](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-x-bare-bones-better-chickens) and [_sheep._](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-x-bare-bones-better-sheep)
